name: good
about: Microsoft's success answer. The stand-in curl is handed exactly request.argv and request.stdin; the secret in stdin.json has & < > " \ + / = % a space and non-ASCII in it, and goes as the form body of request.stdin says.

name: expires-in-as-a-string
about: The older endpoint writes expires_in as a string.

name: proxy-and-ca-variables
about: The nine variables the core hands a command reach curl as they were set, and the script adds no option of its own that would override them.

name: wrong-secret

name: tenant-with-a-slash
about: The tenant is a path segment of the token address. Each character that could leave the segment, or turn it into another address, has a case of its own, since a case with two of them stays refused when one is let through.
